visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman and a young man are seated on a grey fabric sofa against a white wall with vertical slats. The woman on the left wears a blue oversized sweatshirt and black pants, leaning her head on her hand with a bored expression. The man wears a black hoodie over a tiger-graphic t-shirt, also resting his head on his hand and looking pensively away. (2) A close-up shot focuses on the man's face. He maintains his pensive posture, hand on chin, eyes staring into space as if deep in thought about a serious problem. The lighting is soft and neutral, highlighting his dark hair and focused gaze. (3) The camera cuts to a medium shot of the woman. She begins to look toward the man with a suspicious and increasingly irritated facial expression. She adjusted her glasses slightly while continuing to lean on her hand, her long dark hair framing her face against the minimalist background. (4) The woman abruptly stands up from the couch and walks out of the frame to the left. The man reacts with sudden surprise, his hand falling from his face as he looks up and watches her leave with a confused and startled expression. (5) A final close-up shows the man's face as he stares in the direction the woman left. His eyes are wide and his mouth is slightly open, conveying total shock and a lack of understanding regarding the situation that just occurred.
